text:
emma: Noticed a weird pattern during the route-shadow rollout this morning: invoice-preview token totals dip for ~30s and then full invoice has the expected tokens. happening across multiple tenants in us-west. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/preview?mode=shadow

kai: Can you paste one of the raw shadow events? are we double-emitting or dropping?

emma: Sanitized sample 
```
{
  "tenant": "t-omega",
  "req": "req-444",
  "tokens": 60,
  "route": "shadow-v3",
  "emitted_by": "edge-2",
  "preview_indexed": false
}
```

rachel: Interesting. Our preview indexer only reads the primary stream and doesn't yet join the shadow topic. shadows are routed to a different topic until we flip routing. that explains missing preview rows until shadow gets compacted into the committed topic.

dave: Also saw a correlated spike in `routing.quota_requeue` for the same time window. quota enforcement caused some requests to be retried on the shadow path which changes the metadata. logs: `quota.requeue tenant=t-omega route=primary->shadow attempts=1`.

billing-ops: CS tickets increasing. Customers see preview lower than invoice and open cases. We need short-term mitigations to avoid panic.

kai: Options: (A) make preview query join committed + shadow topics and mark shadow rows as "shadow" status; (B) surface a small note in the preview UX that says "shadowing in progress: preview may be incomplete"; (C) temporarily pause shadowing for high-billing tenants.

emma: Preference A + B. A will give parity so previews reflect what finalizer will see after compaction, B reduces noise while we roll. Implementation notes: joining topics in preview indexer is nontrivial but doable: need to de-dup by req id and tag source topic.

rachel: Instrumentation asks: emit `metering.preview_shadow_gap` (per-tenant) and `routing.shadow_quota_requeue` counters. add Grafana panel to track preview vs invoice delta for shadowed routes.

dave: For dedupe we should use `req` as the primary key and a 60s tumbling window in indexer. avoid long-lived in-memory maps. add metric `preview.dedupe_memory_bytes` so we can alert if indexer grows.

billing-ops: For UX: console-ux-bot, can you add a tiny banner copy: "Preview may lag during shadow/rollout activity. Click for details." and a FF `ui.preview_shadow_notice` so we can toggle?

console-ux-bot: ui: added draft copy and FF `ui.preview_shadow_notice` in figma. will attach screenshot to RFC. :white_check_mark:

kai: Plan: 1) add metrics and dashboard (rachel) 2) quick preview-indexer join+dedupe canary (0.5% us-west) (emma + rachel) 3) UI banner behind FF (console-ux) 4) rollback plan if `preview.dedupe_memory_bytes` > 200MB or `metering.preview_shadow_gap` increases.

emma: Scheduling a 15m sync at 09:05 PT to validate canary playbook. please add test vectors that simulate quota requeue -> shadow path.

dave: I'll also add an alert to paging on `metering.preview_shadow_gap > 0.5% for > 5m` for top 50 tenants so we catch regressions.

emma: Thanks all — let's keep shadow rollouts conservative until preview parity is stable. :thumbsup:
